note: outside the 12 cells: the front of 気仙沼市立病院 on the roundabout r17966-r17969 (far core). The two GSI lots 144 and 145 are the hospital's own entrance canopy, not warehouses (src/anime/world/landmarks/sites.js HOSPITAL_FRONT_LOTS tags them as the hospital landmark; the canopy itself is built in landmarks/hospitals.js). These patches keep their data honest: a 1-storey flat concrete canopy, no saw roof. [r3] The hospital's massing is a landmark model, not a lot patch: the 6-storey wing is on the roundabout (SW) face, the NE strip is low terraces (src/anime/world/landmarks/hospitals.js hospitalParts; docs/anime/landmarks/AUDIT.md). Lots 144 and 145 (the canopy) are unchanged.
